decisions.reason: The panel controls use non-interboard connectors, but the source only clarifies the connector inventory's low-pin-count scope and does not change any panel-control mapping, connection mode, or other current attribute.
The clarification does not alter the existing J_LED_CHG connector specification or any charge-status behavior.
The source distinguishes connector categories for a pin-count characteristic but does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
Local decoupling requirements are independent of the clarified low-pin-count scope for connectors.
The source does not change the monitored rail, monitor IC, or current-coverage behavior; nearby current-monitoring discussion is separate.
Interboard connectors are explicitly excluded from the low-pin-count characterization, so their connector types, pinouts, and matching-numbering policy remain unchanged.
The connector pin-count clarification does not affect power-source OR-ing behavior or its component requirements.
LED supply voltage, switching, and logic-level handling remain valid without modification.
The clarification does not alter standalone USB-power activation, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The battery connector's explicit three-pin specification remains unchanged; the source only clarifies the scope of a general main-board connector characteristic.
I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, and population policy are unrelated to connector pin-count scope.
The source does not change connector placement, spacing, enclosure fit, or mounting-hole clearance.
